subject: Packaging options: SOC2+HIPAA add-ons, retention tiers & pilot credits
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@guardwellhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@guardwellhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-21T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Quick: packaging + retention tiers for SOC2/HIPAA (pilot ask)

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and procurement teams asked for a concise breakdown of how Redwood bundles the compliance add-ons: specifically audit-log retention tiers (30/90/365 days), KMS/HSM seat licensing vs throughput billing, and data residency options (US-only vs EU-enabled).

We’re planning a pilot (6 months) for one BU and want to understand:
- Pilot pricing for audit logs (backfill vs streaming only)
- Whether onboarding/implementation fees are waivable for pilots
- If we can get a temporary rollback credit if we exceed retention thresholds during pilot

Can you send a one-pager and an estimated price band for a ~50k token/month pilot and an outline of any minimum commit needed to enable HSM seats?

Appreciate it — Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Platform Security (Guardwell Health)
laura.chen@guardwellhealth.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: example_internal_policy.pdf (reference only)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@guardwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: packaging + retention tiers for SOC2/HIPAA (pilot ask)

Hi Laura — great to hear and happy to outline options. Quick note: looping Ben (account lead) for detailed pricing and Laura Bennett from Pricing to confirm concession paths.

High-level answers up front:
- Audit logs: three retention tiers supported (30/90/365). Pricing is a mix of base ingestion + per-GB-month retention surcharge. For pilots we typically discount the retention surcharge by 50% for the first 3 months (subject to commit).
- KMS/HSM: we offer per-seat HSM licenses OR throughput-based HSM passthrough. Seats are ideal for steady-state; throughput (per-million-ops) is better for pilots to avoid seat minimums.
- Residency: US-only is straightforward; EU-enabled adds a residency premium and may require additional onboarding checklist.

I’ll attach a short pricing sketch and SOW stub. Ben/Laura B — can you review and suggest an acceptable pilot concession (onboarding waiver + retention surcharge discount) that we can offer Guardwell here to accelerate the legal/PO?

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW_pricing_sketch_v1.pdf (draft), SOW_stub_v1.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@guardwellhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: packaging + retention tiers for SOC2/HIPAA (pilot ask)

Laura — thanks for the clear ask. A few specifics from a commercial lens:

Pilot parameters we can offer: 
- Pilot duration: 6 months; committed pilot spend: $50,000 (flexible but helps unlock credits).
- Pricing for audit logs during pilot: base ingestion billed at list; retention surcharge (30/90/365) discounted by 40% for the first 4 months, then 20% for months 5–6. Backfill (historical ingest) billed as one-time at 75% of standard per-GB rate.
- Onboarding: waive the standard onboarding fee ($8k) for the pilot if Guardwell signs a 6-month pilot LOI.
- HSM: provide a temporary throughput billing path (no seat minimum) for the pilot; if you convert to seats within 90 days post-pilot, we’ll credit 50% of pilot throughput fees against first-year seat licenses.

If this sounds reasonable I can mark it as a pilot concession and we’ll prepare a short LOI/SOW. We’ll need procurement contact + PO cadence to proceed.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot-pricing-v2.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: packaging + retention tiers for SOC2/HIPAA (pilot ask)

Ben/Olga — from a pricing governance perspective I’m ok to approve:
- onboarding fee waiver for the 6-month pilot,
- retention surcharge discount 40% → 20% taper as proposed, and
- throughput-to-seat credit (50%) on conversion.

Two asks before we send to Guardwell:
1) Limit the onboarding waiver to one-time per-customer (standard language).
2) Add a clause capping exposure: if retained volume exceeds 3x forecast in any month, we reserve the right to renegotiate retention surcharge for the following month.

If both are acceptable, Ben please prepare LOI + SOW (I’ll fast-track legal review).

—Laura B
VP, Pricing & Packaging
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@guardwellhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@guardwellhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-24T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: packaging + retention tiers for SOC2/HIPAA (pilot ask)

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility. A couple follow-ups from procurement/security: 
- We need an explicit commitment that audit evidence (SOCs, attestation) will be provided within 30 days of signature.
- Can the onboarding waiver be extended to include the evidence-delivery checklist (i.e., Redwood will provide the evidence checklist and one initial attestation review at no cost for the pilot)?
- For HSM throughput billing, please clarify the meter: is it ops/sec? or API-calls-per-month? We prefer monthly units.

We’re prepared to sign a 6-month LOI at $50k net spend if those items are included. Also need a short SOW + DocuSign link.

Laura
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@guardwellhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Quick: packaging + retention tiers for SOC2/HIPAA (pilot ask)

Laura — thanks, quick confirmations inline and sending the DocuSign + SOW stub now.

- Evidence/attestation: Redwood will deliver the requested SOC2 attestation (redacted) and a delivery date commitment within 30 days of signature. We’ll include the evidence checklist as an attached deliverable and perform one complimentary attestation review during the pilot. (Attachment: evidence-checklist.xlsx)
- HSM meter: we will bill throughput as API-ops-per-month (aggregated monthly bucket). You’ll see ops reported in the Console under Billing → HSM usage.
- Onboarding waiver: applied for this pilot; limited to one-time per-customer per standard clause.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/EXAMPLE-DOCUSIGN-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/57423/GW-2028-0421

I’ve attached the SOW stub (RW_SOW_Guardwell_v1.pdf) and the pricing breakdown CSV (pricing-breakdown.csv). If Guardwell confirms, we’ll route LOI + SOW to legal and can aim for signature by end of week.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
